title: Mrs. Ruth's Pantry

readiness.reading: first sounds (younger); reading short words by sounding out (older)

concepts: labels tell us what is inside

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Come in, come in! My pantry shelf is all in a muddle. I can never find my pot when I need it!

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Could you help me make labels for the shelf? Then everything will have its place.

steps.speaker: ruth
steps.prompt: Listen to each name. Which letter makes its first sound? Put that letter under the picture.

older.prompt: Read each label. Tap it to hear its sounds, then put it under the right picture.

feedback.all_good: Every shelf has its label. Now I'll always find my pot!

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: What a tidy pantry! Thank you, little one. Come and have a cup of milk any time.

journal_line: I made labels for Mrs. Ruth's pantry shelf.
unavailable_text: Mrs. Ruth's pantry has its labels. Everything has its place.
